note: 折外判定数据；由 models/oof_bundle_119.json 精简导出，字段含义见 assets 内 README

protocol.cv: stratified 5-fold outer (random_state=42); 4-fold inner for calibration fitting (random_state=100+fold)
protocol.note: identical folds/seed/features as scripts/evaluate_system.py; no hyper-parameter or threshold selection on held-out folds
protocol.calibration: per-member temperature scaling (Guo et al. 2017); the temperature of a fold is fitted on inner-CV logits of the training fold, then applied to the held-out fold

members.forensic: LR on L1(47)+L1b(20) forensic/domain features (trainable, deployed)
members.combined: LR on L1(47)+L1b(20)+CLIP global(1024)+CLIP tiles(3072) (trainable, deployed)
members.clip_domain: LR on CLIP global features(1024) only (trainable, ablation channel)
members.clip_external: frozen CLIP probe trained on the 18-generator benchmark (never trained on the 119)
members.npr: frozen NPR ResNet-18 logits on external benchmark shards (never trained on the 119)
